walkthroughs.body_html: Click Make a Variable and call it score. Use set score to 0 at start and change score by 1 when you score a point.
Use touching sprite? or touching colour? inside an if. Detect when the player hits a coin or an enemy.
Compare the score: if score = 10 then say You win! Broadcast 'game over' so all sprites stop together.
